repo_context.description: Sub-manifest for horizon/ — Horizon customer storefront with scalable catalog, cart, and gated shared Square/Printful commerce.

purpose.summary: Public noindex storefront for Horizon aerial art. Four consumer works appear on one finite proportional gallery wall, Harbor appears in business placement, and archived, incomplete, and bundle records remain hidden but recoverable. The storefront includes a Horizon-namespaced cart and Square-hosted checkout for all five public works. Eight production checkout keys and eight production mapping rows are verified; unresolved physical-proof work remains transparent in private catalog waivers.
purpose.source_of_truth_policy: SOT: horizon/ is the canonical Horizon frontend source. Product and commerce-readiness data is maintained in catalog.json; store-level routing is maintained in store.json. planning/canvas is design provenance only.
purpose.business_role: Customer storefront for Horizon aerial fine-art prints (second AeroVista store).

backend: Shared store/backend Flask Square and Printful bridge
infra: GitHub Pages at horizon.aerovista.us behind Cloudflare

deployment.primary_host: GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare Worker Custom Domain
deployment.networking_notes: Cloudflare owns the horizon.aerovista.us Custom Domain, proxies static requests to GitHub Pages, and sends /api/* to the NXCore API. Backend CORS includes the Horizon origin. Eight Horizon checkout keys and eight production mappings are active. noindex is set in index.html.

entrypoints.label: Horizon storefront shell
entrypoints.notes: Public noindex storefront with four proportional consumer-wall presentations, one Harbor business-placement presentation, no public placeholders, a hidden bundle, and Square-hosted checkout for all five public works.

governance.update_rule: Update this manifest and ../SOT.json in the same change set as any Horizon canon or deploy change.
governance.promotion_rule: Enable checkout only after exact catalog, Square, production mapping, policy, and launch checks pass. Any intentional proof exception must be recorded as an explicit catalog commerce approval and proof waiver; do not mark proofApproved without a received proof.

notes: Design source: planning/canvas (Horizon Canvas Gallery demo). Images byte-verified on copy.

Five products are public in the noindex storefront: four consumer works on one proportional wall and Harbor in business placement. No placeholder is public. Autumn and the other archived records remain recoverable, the bundle remains hidden, and the five public variants are checkout-ready through Square. Eight checkout keys and eight production mapping rows are active. View in Room uses a generated photorealistic lake-house background and catalog-dimension scaling. Canvas wrap geometry uses one continuous image map across the front, reduced-depth right fold, retained thin bottom fold, and joined lower-right corner; physical-proof follow-up remains recorded privately.
